description: Extracts student personal information and academic course records from university and college transcripts in any format.

student_name.instruction: Full name of the student as it appears on the transcript.

student_id.instruction: Student ID, student number, or enrollment number on the transcript.

date_of_birth.instruction: Student date of birth. Return in MM/DD/YYYY format if available.

email.instruction: Student email address if present on the transcript.

phone.instruction: Student phone number if present on the transcript.

address.instruction: Student mailing or home address if present on the transcript.

institution.instruction: Full name of the college or university that issued the transcript.

program.instruction: Degree program, e.g. Bachelor of Science, Associate in Arts, Associate in Pre-Nursing DTA/MRP.

major.instruction: Student declared major or field of study.

enrollment_date.instruction: Date the student first enrolled at the institution.

graduation_date.instruction: Degree conferral or graduation date. Also called Confer Date.

gpa.instruction: Cumulative GPA as a number, e.g. 3.75. Also called Cum GPA, QPR, or overall GPA. Use the final cumulative value.

total_credits.instruction: Total credits earned across all terms. Also called Cum Totals earned credits or total hours earned.

courses.instruction: List of every course taken by the student across all terms and semesters. Include transfer courses.

course_code.instruction: Course code or number, e.g. MATH 151, DHYG124, CS 301.

course_name.instruction: Full course title, e.g. Calculus, Dental Radiology, Introduction to Psychology.

credits.instruction: Credit hours earned. Also called units or earned hours.

grade.instruction: Letter grade received, e.g. A, B+, C-, W, TR for transfer, S for satisfactory.

grade_points.instruction: Quality points or grade points earned for this course, e.g. 12.00, 16.65.

semester.instruction: Term when the course was taken, e.g. FALL 2018, SPRING 2007, WINTER 2019.

year.instruction: Academic year when the course was taken, e.g. 2018, 2022.

department.instruction: Department code, e.g. MATH, DHYG, ENGL.

status.instruction: Course status: Completed, Transfer, Withdrawn, or In Progress.
